summary: Tested ECP payment edit feature (PATCH /api/payments/{id} + ECPDetail Edit dialog). All 6 backend pytest cases passed and end-to-end UI flow verified as ACCOUNTS (edit, prefill, save, toast, stage-unchanged, no-dup). RBAC verified: OWNER and MANAGER do not see the Edit button and backend rejects them with 403. current_stage is unchanged before/after the payment update; payment type not editable; payment count unchanged; POST /api/payments still works.
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentUpdate model accepts any string status but only PENDING/CONFIRMED validated inside handler — OK but could be enforced by Enum on Pydantic model.
update_payment does not validate that at least one field is provided; empty PATCH still succeeds and only writes audit fields. Minor.
ECPDetail.jsx: Edit dialog does not currently show client-side validation (e.g., empty amount, missing date). Server 400 will show a toast but a small local guard would improve UX.
